item.title: Veteran shot twice while protecting friend in Richmond bar still seeks justice
item.description: A military veteran who was shot twice trying to protect a friend at a South Richmond bar last year is asking anyone with information to come forward to police.

item.title: Police share new details after arrest of Richmond driver in deadly hit-and-run
item.description: Richmond police have arrested the driver they say is responsible for a deadly hit-and-run along Semmes Avenue that killed a 26-year-old woman walking her dog just 3 days into the new year.

item.title: Davidson downs Richmond 65-63
item.description: Backup Roberts Blums scored 18 points and grabbed 13 rebounds and Davidson held on to beat Richmond 65-63 on Wednesday.
